# Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit — Transverse Thread

This path preserves one movement across the stations rather than making trust a detachable theme. The formal limit exposes the rational account's assumed ground; humility receives that exposure without abandoning reason; knowledge then becomes either a provisional anchor or an instrument of projected distrust; faith names the active continuation where no final ground can be possessed. The thread passes through psyche, politics, infrastructure, and the agentic field without allowing any one register to define the relation for the others.

1. [[04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy|§0/1 · #3 — The Formal-Limit Genealogy]] establishes the limit intrinsic to a self-accounting rational system.
2. [[19-s2-p0-difference-cannot-be-escaped|§2 · #0 — Difference Cannot Be Escaped]] names knowledge's dependence on a relation it cannot certify from inside itself.
3. [[20-s2-p1-dia-ballein|§2 · #1 — Dia-Ballein]] follows the unheld remainder into projection, scapegoating, atomisation, and false totality.
4. [[21-s2-p2-sym-ballein|§2 · #2 — Sym-Ballein]] gives determinate knowledge its proper task: a provisional anchor which does not claim to replace the relation beneath it.
5. [[22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia|§2 · #3 — Ares, Aphrodite, Harmonia, Eros, and Hephaestus]] gives reliance a complete capture-and-release sequence. The forged bonds establish capture and public proof; the gods’ different responses keep exposure distinct from settlement. The payment dispute ends in Poseidon undertaking the debt if Ares evades it; Hephaestus accepts that named liability and releases the pair. Harmonia’s separate Hesiodic genealogy retains the productive relation’s own source, without turning it into another episode in the Homeric song.
6. [[38-s5-p1-apoha-softmax|§5 · #1 — Actuation: Living Articulation]] brings the issue into preference and evaluation. A score inherits its comparison field, evaluator and reference conditions. Making them inspectable gives a challenge an address. A corrected source, answer, task or model can change what is warranted under an adequate criterion; an exposed failure of the evaluator, permission or commission needs the authority capable of remedying it. An adequate condition can be retained with a reason. Trust also depends on who answers for the score’s use, who bears the consequences of reliance and what the next decision inherits from this examination.
7. [[44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness|§5→0 · #1 — QL, MEF, Bimba, and Harness]] makes return structurally inspectable without claiming that an inspectable system has generated the trust it requires.
8. [[48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return|§5→0 · #5→0 — AHI and Planetary Return]] releases the argument at the formal limit, where faith is neither closure nor a blind leap but lucid continuation.

The source of the complete authorial movement remains [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust|Taylor — Revision Notes on Trust and F-Blocks (2026)]], read with [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3|Taylor — The Definition of God, Draft 3 (2026)]].
